name: tween2d
description: Smooth changes of a number over time: a value that slides from one number to another along a curve, or that settles towards a goal. Any numeric field of any component can be animated (a position, a size, a transparency, a colour, a bar), so a pop, a fade, a slide or a smooth gauge are data, not code. It runs in the simulation, so animations are the same on every run and machine.

components.name: Tween
components.description: Moves a number from from to to in ticks simulation ticks, after waiting delay ticks. field names the number ("module.Component.field", for example "transform2d.Scale.factor") on the entity itself, or with on_owner on the entity that is this one's transform2d.Owner (a tween entity made for another one). easing is the curve: 0 linear, 1 slow start, 2 slow end, 3 slow start and end, 4 overshoots the goal a little before settling. With from_current the start is the number's value when the tween begins, and from is ignored. When it is done and use_action, the action is raised; with despawn_when_done the entity is destroyed, otherwise the Tween is removed (the entity stays). Components that are missing leave the tween with nothing to move: it still runs and ends.

components.name: Settle
components.description: Keeps a number going towards toward: every tick it covers the share rate (0 to 1) of what is left, so it slows down as it arrives, and it lands exactly once it is within a hundredth. field and on_owner as for Tween. Unlike a Tween it never ends: change toward (or the number) and it follows. A smooth gauge, a pop that relaxes back to 1, a value that eases to what the game sets.

components.name: Track
components.description: A number played along keys: for keys keys (2 to 6), the number field ("camera2d.Camera.zoom") of the entity that answers to onto (a tag.Tag; none: this entity) is v0 at tick t0, v1 at tick t1 and so on (the ticks are counted from the start and go up), and slides from one to the next, smoothly at both ends of each slide with smooth. It starts on the first tick, or with start when that action is pressed; before its first key it is not written, after its last it is left at the last value and end_action is pressed once (none: nothing); with loop it starts again from its first key instead, for ever (a spin, a sway, a pulse). Several Tracks can play several numbers of the same entity at once: a camera that moves, zooms and fades in a cut scene. The module keeps started, elapsed (ticks since the start) and done.

systems.name: run
systems.description: Advances every Tween by one tick and writes the number it gives.

systems.name: settle
systems.description: Moves every Settle's number a share of the way to its goal.

systems.name: play
systems.description: Moves every started Track one tick on and writes its number.
